test.create_query: CREATE TABLE window_functions_qualify (k UInt64, g UInt32, v UInt32, s String) ENGINE = MergeTree ORDER BY tuple()
test.fill_query: INSERT INTO window_functions_qualify SELECT sipHash64(number) % 18000000, number % 300000, (number * 7919) % 1000000, toString(number) FROM numbers_mt(30000000)
test.query: SELECT k, v, s FROM window_functions_qualify QUALIFY count() OVER (PARTITION BY k) = 1 FORMAT Null
SELECT k, v FROM window_functions_qualify QUALIFY count() OVER (PARTITION BY k) > 1 FORMAT Null
SELECT g, v FROM window_functions_qualify QUALIFY row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY g ORDER BY v DESC) <= 3 FORMAT Null
SELECT g, v FROM window_functions_qualify QUALIFY rank() OVER (PARTITION BY g ORDER BY v DESC) <= 3 FORMAT Null
SELECT g, v, count() OVER (PARTITION BY g) AS c FROM window_functions_qualify QUALIFY row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY g ORDER BY k DESC) = 1 AND c > 50 FORMAT Null
